title: .cursorignore does not stop Cursor Agent from reading ignored files through the terminal or MCP tools
symptoms: Agent runs cat on a file listed in .cursorignore and sees its contents
An MCP tool returns data from an ignored folder
cause: Cursor blocks ignored files from its own file reads, Tab, Inline Edit, and @ mentions, but terminal commands and MCP tools run outside those controls.
fix: Keep real credentials out of the workspace. For the CLI add Read and Shell deny rules; in the editor rely on the sandbox read boundary and Run Mode approvals for shell access.
affected: Cursor editor Agent and Cursor CLI, as of 2026-10
